rationale: PINS the union_item and associated_type completeness gaps (2026-08-28): `pub union Pixel` must emit a struct symbol with its fields (the grammar node is union_item, not struct_item — previously emitted NOTHING), and the trait-level `type Item;` (associated_type node) must emit a Type symbol owned by the trait. Impl-level `type Item = u32` stays a type_item symbol owned by the impl type. A regression that drops either declaration site fails this fixture.
